profile.summary: Full-stack software developer (JavaScript/Python) committed to driving innovation and quality into new products and systems. Customer-oriented with a focus on leveraging domain knowledge and prior experiences to identify new opportunities that improve customer satisfaction, overall process execution, and mitigate risks/issues.

positions.title: Co-Founder/CTO
positions.description:
•	Developed a mobile-friendly, highly available, and scalable web application that teaches users about their personal finances and connects them to the best financial products/services.
•	Designed/implemented the frontend application using HTML5, Bootstrap, CSS, JavaScript, & jQuery.
•	Built the backend application using python’s Flask framework, open-source libraries, and a PostgreSQL database.
•	Hosted the application on Amazon Web Services using Elastic Beanstalk and an application load balancer.
•	Supported the application with AWS services ranging from Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, RDS, Route 53, SES, VPC, and more.
•	Integrated Jenkins & Git with AWS Elastic Beanstalk for continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) 
•	Configured virtual environments, builds, config files, test environments, and unit testing (PyTest)
•	Managed security permissions, user authentication, tokens, and sessions/cookie data
•	Implemented REST APIs, integrated 3rd party plug-ins and apps, and site monitoring using Google Analytics
•	GA Tech’s CREATE-X winner, Snap Inc.’s Yellow Accelerator finalist, and QC FinTech Accelerator finalist.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer II
positions.description: Led the on-time delivery and development of TrueCourse's AOC software to Technical Readiness Level 4 (TRL 4) for basic flight planning uplinking/downlinking processing and supported key customer demos. Developed a plan and strategy for incrementally building up the AOC functionality based on program needs and scheduled customer demos. I on-boarded, mentored, and defined work assignments for several team members. I applied heavy focus towards leveraging legacy code, modularizing software components to maximize re-use, and reducing complexity and source lines of code.

positions.title: Software/Systems Test Engineer I
positions.description: Reviewed the test and services requirements of a remote interface unit. Authored robust verification test artifacts—including test descriptions, test cases, and test procedures. Performed dry-runs on test hardware and formal reviews of independent test artifacts with project focals. Collaborated with sister-sites' program leaders to refine the verification process guidance for global execution. Led one of the six global verification teams that produced the most formally-approved test artifacts. Developed two Python scripts to simplify program tasks and mentored other team members on verification activities.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Edison Leadership Development Program 2nd Rotation

Led the development of a next-gen B737 datalink feature. Performed feature focal and customer account manager responsibilities and managed the budget and schedule of a team of five engineers. Developed ~300 high-level requirements (HLRs) and designed/implemented the SW architecture. Delivered the HLRs with zero customer issues and completed the feature per the customer schedule.

positions.title: Junior Software Lead
positions.description:
Edison Leadership Development Program 1st Rotation

Collected program-level metrics and reported out key insights regarding risks/issues to senior management to best meet program objectives. Analyzed and dispositioned issues impacting home-grown tools into two categories: tool issues and requirement issues. The early identification of tool-related issues, coupled with weekly metric report outs, resulted in a new development approach to meet critical program deadlines. 

Led the configuration effort of TrueCourse's test artifacts and resolved tasks that enabled the program's software/hardware teams to begin the development of first flight verification artifacts on time by organizing the set up of modules, access/metrics/triggers via scripts, and views/attributes.

Assisted in day-to-day SW Lead responsibilities by facilitating planning document updates/reviews, earned value reporting, collecting metrics, performing SLOC analysis, organizing activities, identifying program inefficiencies, supporting sub-section managers, and leading individual tasks.

positions.title: NC State Engineering Ambassador
positions.description: The Engineering Ambassador team strives to reach a broad population of individuals in the NC State community and beyond. From fostering an interest in STEM for young students to paving the way to student success for current engineering students, our Engineering Ambassador team seeks to shape their community into one that is well-supported and engaged. The team’s impact encompasses three areas: Recruitment, Outreach, and First-Year Engineering.

positions.title: Embedded Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed a version request handshake protocol across two routers. The implemented protocol phased out old versions of software, upgraded/added features to the new version(s), and converted internal messages to TLV format.

Improved team efficiency by 44% by eliminated communication bottleneck between two processes.

Designed a soft-recovery solution to a pre-existing fault in a XAUI driver that prevented routers from forwarding packets.

Improved the capability of an existing Packet Trace debug tool by integrating Layer-2 Encapsulation Identification support.

positions.title: SW Test Engineer - GE Intelligent Platforms
positions.description:
Reduced the frequency of failed builds by 45% and the failed automated unit tests by 99% by designing and implementing a Nightly Build Dashboard—an internal website—to report the real-time status of nightly builds, automated unit tests, and other build-related information.

Contributed to the validation of the Mark VIe Control System with regression testing by creating automated unit tests & identifying bugs/issues with code and/or documentation.

positions.description: Researched available software offerings for R4 internal website and collaborated with off-site IT team to maintain on-site network stability.
